scope: isolated authorization service and opt-in runtime read chain; no production activation

cases.expect: deny inactive, cross-tenant, deleted or noncurrent
same authorized tenant administrator can propose and confirm once
wrong digest, changed payload or expired proposal cannot execute
revoked/demoted proposer or unavailable grantee denies execution
stale ACL revision cannot consume proposal or change grants
audit failure or caller rollback retains old ACL and unconsumed proposal
at most one permission transition and one change audit
native/langchain/llamaindex do not return restricted text without current grant
deny when ACL enabled and subject absent
ACL mode rejects background generation without persistent subject binding

observed_regressions.expect: restricted candidate, model context, citation and summary require a current grant
